title: Bronze Saver Account: Withdrawal limits explained
summary: Bronze Saver Account allows up to 12 free withdrawals per month. After that, each additional withdrawal is charged a $3.00 excess withdrawal fee. The document lists common withdrawal types (ACH to external banks, outgoing wires, internal transfers, and cash withdrawals) and provides tips to stay within the limit.
faqs: How many free withdrawals can I make from my Bronze Saver Account each month?
What fee do I pay if I exceed 12 withdrawals in a month?
Which activities count as a “withdrawal” for this limit (ACH, wire, internal transfers, cash)?
Do internal transfers from my savings to other accounts count toward the 12-withdrawal limit?
How can I avoid excess withdrawal fees near the end of my statement cycle?
